description: This file defines the class CleanCSV, which provides functionality to sanitize CSV fields by escaping certain starting characters, and includes configuration and access methods for its properties.

classes.name: CleanCSV
classes.description: A class that handles escaping CSV fields based on specific starting characters, with configurable escape character and starting characters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the escape character and starting characters for escaping CSV fields.

methods.name: getStartingChars
methods.description: Returns the array of characters that need to be escaped if they appear at the start of a cell.

methods.name: getEscapeChar
methods.description: Returns the escape character used to escape fields.

methods.name: escapeField
methods.description: Escapes a CSV cell if it starts with one of the specified starting characters, by prepending the escape character.
